column1: # THE INTERPRETATION CONTRACT, FROZEN AT C1 BEFORE THE CORRECTION
# It states, in advance, HOW the route-scoped and decision-owner
# questions are to be answered. The verifier and the independent
# witness implement THIS contract. Neither may change it.
# The C-selected option field values ON THIS ROUTE, derived from the
# frozen src/cli.c option table and the frozen route matrix:
# A branch is PROVEN_REACHABLE_ON_REQUIRED_ROUTE iff the frozen source
# shows the branch's guard is TRUE on the required route. A branch
# whose guard is FALSE on the required route is PROVEN_UNREACHABLE_ON_
# REQUIRED_ROUTE with a concrete flag-absence argument.
# PROVEN_UNREACHABLE REQUIRES a concrete control-flow or flag-absence
# argument. ABSENCE FROM A FIXTURE CORPUS IS NOT AN ARGUMENT.
# FUNCTION_REACHABLE_ON_ROUTE. The route scope is a PER-BRANCH fact.
# Three SEPARATE questions are asked of every retained-C candidate:
#   WHO SELECTS THE INTENT?       the component that decides WHAT the
#   ACTION?                       the component that decides WHICH
#   WHO EXECUTES THE ACTION?      the component that performs it
#       the PolyC driver selected the intent AND the action, and the C
#       branch merely realises the already-selected action
#       the C branch makes a policy choice that the PolyC decision did
#       the evidence does not separate the two
# A C BRANCH THAT CONSUMES A POLYC-SELECTED FIELD IS NOT, BY THAT
# FACT ALONE, A C POLICY OWNER. The C branch must be shown to MAP the
# selected value to a SEPARATE C policy choice.
# A LINKED COUNTERFACTUAL ESTABLISHES CAUSAL INFLUENCE ONLY. IT DOES
# NOT ESTABLISH EXCLUSIVE AUTHORITY. SUPPRESSING A BRANCH AND SEEING
# THE BEHAVIOUR CHANGE PROVES THE BRANCH IS IN THE CAUSAL PATH; IT
# DOES NOT PROVE THE BRANCH IS THE OWNER OF THE DECISION.
#       the historical 32-row classification, PRESERVED AS RECORDED
#       branch-level branches proven to select behaviour on SOME route
#       branch-level branches proven to select behaviour ON THE FROZEN
# THE HISTORICAL 32-ROW COUNT AND THE NEW BRANCH-LEVEL COUNT MAY
# DIFFER. THEY ARE REPORTED SEPARATELY WITH AN EXPLICIT CROSSWALK AND
#   * mutate the FROZEN src/main.c at the exact branch line
#   * be built by the REAL production CMake build
#   * be LINKED into the binary that is actually EXECUTED
#   * record the BASELINE, MUTANT and RESTORED source digests
#   * record the BASELINE and MUTANT BINARY digests
#   * record the artifact TYPE, not merely its existence
#   * RESTORE the source and prove the restoration by digest
# A SOURCE MUTATION THAT WAS NEVER LINKED INTO THE EXECUTED BINARY
# THE PRISTINE STAGE0 COMPILER IS PROTECTED FROM THE MUTATION. THE
# WORKING PRODUCTION COMPILER IS NEVER REPLACED BY A MUTANT.
#   FRESH_MEASUREMENT      what this correction measures NOW
# A NOT_REMEASURED HISTORICAL VALUE STAYS NOT_REMEASURED. IT IS NEVER
# CONVERTED INTO A FRESH PASS. A CORRECTION MAY PERFORM A NEW
# MEASUREMENT, BUT THAT IS NEW EVIDENCE, NOT A CHANGE TO THE HISTORICAL

column2: real CMake build + real link + source/object/binary digests + artifact type
preserved as recorded, reported separately from the branch-level counts
historical value, fresh measurement and conservation verdict are distinct
